segments.source: The time marker groups that provide ways to navigate the player item’s content.
segments.ko: The time marker groups that provide ways to navigate the player item’s content.

segments.source: A navigation marker group provides a set of time markers for navigating playback.
segments.ko: A navigation marker group provides a set of time markers for navigating playback.

segments.source: The most common form of navigation marker group is a chapter list; however, you can also provide other sets of markers to allow a user to jump to significant events in the presentation.
segments.ko: The most common form of navigation marker group is a chapter list; however, you can also provide other sets of markers to allow a user to jump to significant events in the presentation.

segments.source: For example, a “Goals Scored” marker group might summarize key moments in a recorded sporting event.
segments.ko: For example, a “Goals Scored” marker group might summarize key moments in a recorded sporting event.

segments.source: When you present a player item containing marker groups with the [`AVPlayerViewController`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AVKit/AVPlayerViewController) class, the user interface provides options for navigating each group.
segments.ko: When you present a player item containing marker groups with the [`AVPlayerViewController`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AVKit/AVPlayerViewController) class, the user interface provides options for navigating each group.

segments.source: To provide a chapter list, use the first item in the [`navigationMarkerGroups`](avplayeritem/navigationmarkergroups.md) array and set its title property to `nil`.
segments.ko: 챕터 목록을 제공하려면 [`navigationMarkerGroups`](avplayeritem/navigationmarkergroups.md) 배열의 첫 번째 항목을 사용하고 해당 항목의 `title` 속성을 `nil`로 설정합니다.

segments.source: To provide additional or alternate means of navigating content, use a unique title value for each navigation marker group in the array.
segments.ko: 콘텐츠 탐색을 위한 추가 또는 대체 수단을 제공하려면 배열의 각 navigation marker group에 고유한 title 값을 사용합니다.

segments.source: The item proposed to follow the current content.
